$comment: WAL-218 — CI GREEN != GOLDEN CHAIN VERIFIED.
Golden #1 (LS&DL 5 Bai 8) is the only place where the whole delivery chain is
pinned end to end: source -> SDM -> repair ledger -> ValidatedRepair -> projected
Learning Views. The fixture that carries it is gitignored under Founder D4
(verbatim SGK text and page crops are INTERNAL / RESEARCH ONLY), so CI never has
it and every assertion below turns into markTestSkipped on the runner.
Before WAL-218 that was invisible: nine tests skipped and `flutter test` still
printed 'All tests passed!'. This file is the list those nine tests must report
against. Absence cannot satisfy a positive obligation: a run with no fixture
records nine UNVERIFIED rows and can never be reported as a Golden-chain PASS.
Adding a Golden-chain assertion means adding a row here AND calling
recordGoldenChain(<id>) from the test. Deleting a test without deleting its row
makes tool/ci/golden_chain_verdict.py exit 2 (an obligation vanished); deleting
both drops `declared` below the --min-obligations floor pinned in
.github/workflows/ci.yml, which also goes red. Two files, on purpose.

obligations.claim: WorkspaceCatalog loads the REAL path and does not fall back to the synthetic one when both are present
the document declares all five version fields (sourceHash, pipelineVersion, sdmVersion, generator, tslPath) and repair provenance with trusted = 0
every repaired region stays WITHHELD and still carries no text key
withheld regions reach the app model as reasoned gaps, and the model carries no text for them
the three Learning Views open on the real lesson and the non-dismissable «chua kiem dinh» chip stays
no repair record carries a text-bearing key, every record is servable=false / VALIDATED_REPAIR, and no pipeline vocabulary reaches the Read screen
the seven-milestone block is PRESENT, WITHHELD, carries a non-servable VALIDATED_REPAIR — and no timeline is built while it is untrusted
document-level repair accounting tells the truth: 6 regions repaired, 0 trusted, no production trust threshold
story attributions are derived only from blocks that are still served
